subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): reject oversized apply body files

question: Should `openclaw wiki apply synthesis --body-file` adopt an unconditional 1 MiB limit as its supported CLI contract?
rationale: The limit fixes unbounded buffering but intentionally makes some previously accepted inputs fail, and no existing mutation or documentation contract establishes 1 MiB.

options.title: Approve and document 1 MiB
options.body: Keep the bounded reader, expose the limit in CLI help or plugin documentation, and prove exact-limit success plus oversized rejection.

options.title: Choose another shared limit
options.body: Define an owner-approved synthesis-body limit and use that contract consistently in the CLI boundary and focused tests.

options.title: Defer the hard limit
options.body: Pause this PR until a broader streaming or mutation-size design can avoid an arbitrary CLI-only compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve and document 1 MiB
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded reader, expose the limit in CLI help or plugin documentation, and prove exact-limit success plus oversized rejection.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the apply CLI and has the strongest history on the memory-wiki command and mutation boundary.
